d: Company Description MyFatoorah is the Middle East’s leading payment gateway, providing smart payment solutions that enable businesses to manage seamless online transactions and instant invoicing. The secure platform integrates with major banks to accelerate settlements and streamline financial operations. MyFatoorah focuses on delivering an efficient, user-friendly payment experience that supports business growth and digital transformation. Thousands of enterprises across the region rely on MyFatoorah to modernize how they handle payments and enhance their financial workflows.

Role Description The Business Office Specialist is a full-time, on-site role based in Kuwait City, responsible for supporting daily office and financial operations. This role includes managing documentation, maintaining accurate records, handling accounts receivable, and coordinating with internal teams to ensure timely payment processing and reporting. The specialist will assist with data entry, invoice tracking, reconciliations, and follow-up on outstanding balances, while adhering to company policies and regulatory requirements. The role also involves responding to inquiries from clients and colleagues, preparing routine reports, and contributing to process improvements that enhance efficiency and accuracy within the business office.
q: Candidates should possess strong Office Administration skills, including documentation management and organizational abilities.
Candidates should possess knowledge of Accounts Receivable (AR), including invoice processing, collections follow-up, and basic reconciliation.
Candidates should possess familiarity with Healthcare operations, Medical Terminology, and Medical Records management, where relevant to client or partner segments.
Candidates should possess proficiency in MS Office or similar productivity tools, with strong Excel skills for data handling and reporting.
Candidates should possess strong attention to detail, numerical accuracy, and the ability to manage multiple tasks within set deadlines.
Candidates should possess effective written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in an office environment.
Relevant diploma or bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or a related field is preferred.
Experience in financial services, payment gateways, banking, or healthcare-related business offices is an advantage.
